name: Rubblebelt
description: The ruined wild district of Ravnica that is weakening and dying.

timeline.summary: Mazena orders Ruzi to leave today for the Rubblebelt because Trostani sensed a troubling situation.
timeline.quote: You must go to the Rubblebelt. You must leave today.

timeline.summary: Clanless, Arrus notices the Rubblebelt's plants, animals and food are all failing and tries to warn Jiri, who refuses to listen.
timeline.quote: Something's been sucking the life out of the Rubblebelt these last couple months.

pages_say.description: A ruined tract of land beyond the Tenth District where Cecilee's community lives.
The ruined region of Ravnica that is home to the Gruul.
The ruined region where the Gruul live.
A rubble-strewn district whose dust is full of dragon bone and where Brazer's bunker sits.
The ruined wild district of Ravnica that is weakening and dying.
A district where Kellan says his friend went to explore a ruin.
